source_differences: Length: lift-world 1643 m vs 2006 official list 1442 m. The coordinate geometry (valley 46.3055,14.6086 to OSM top 46.3037,14.6260: ~1.35 km horizontal, 858 m rise) fits ~1.6 km, i.e. lift-world's 1643 m, 1442 m looks wrong or refers to something else.

Year: lift-world 1991 (manufacturer Hölzl) vs 2006 list 1963 vs Kamnik museum 'officially opened 13 Sept 1964'. 1964 is the opening of the line, 1991/Hölzl is probably a rebuild (not confirmed by a second source).
Capacity/speed: lift-world 300 p/h, 8 m/s vs 2006 list 360 p/h, 7 m/s.
Station elevations: lift-world 558/1416 m vs 2006 list 548/1405 m.
Operator in 2006 list: 'Zaklad narave, Kamnik', today Velika planina d.o.o. (RTV SLO). Record client 'Velika planina d.o.o.' matches the current operator.
Top station coordinate in the earlier note (46.303726, 14.625989, Mapcarta/OSM) could not be opened (mapcarta page not found by search), not verified.
Uradni list 2006 vs lift-world: capacity 360 vs 300 p/h, slope length 1442 vs 1643 m, stations 548/1405 vs 558/1416 m.
